Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Word Class: Nouns (which only occur in singular or plural)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Word Class: Nouns (which only occur in singular or plural), part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: which only occur in singular or plural such as news, dirt, waste and rubbish, 1. Why is it important to use words correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify nouns which only occur in singular or plural from given sentences,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Word Class: Nouns (which only occur in singular or plural) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use nouns which only occur in singular or plural to make sentences, Learner is guided to: • Identify and underline nouns which only occur in singular or plural sentences, • Construct sentences with peers using nouns which only occur in singular or plural such as news, dirt, waste and rubbish, 1.
